zh: 子序列必须保序，但中位数只看所选元素排序后的结果，所以选哪些位置都无所谓，只关心选了哪些值。
设 j = ⌈k/2⌉。任意 k 个数里的第 j 小，不会小于整个数组的第 j 小，也不会大于整个数组的第 n−k+j 小；这两个界分别由最小的 k 项和最大的 k 项取到。
把数组升序排序，令 middle = (k−1)/2（0 下标），最大中位数是 a[n−k+middle]，最小中位数是 a[middle]，按“最大 最小”的顺序输出。
en: The subsequence must keep its order, but the median only looks at the chosen values after sorting, so which positions you pick does not matter, only which values.

Let j = ceil(k/2). The j-th smallest of any k chosen values can be no smaller than the j-th smallest of the whole array and no larger than its (n-k+j)-th smallest; the k smallest items and the k largest items reach these two bounds.
Sort the array ascending and let middle = (k-1)/2 (0-based); the maximum median is a[n-k+middle] and the minimum median is a[middle]; print them in the order maximum, minimum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the array. The minimum median comes from the k smallest items, and the maximum median comes from the k largest items.

## Proof of correctness

The j-th smallest of any k items can be neither smaller than the global j-th smallest nor larger than the global (n-k+j)-th smallest. The k smallest items and the k largest items reach these two bounds respectively.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
